title: fix(app-shell): the new-package form offers no scope the install door refuses (objectui#12869)
body:
Fixes #12869
Clause-②: no

## What changed

- `package-schema.ts`: `getPackageForm(locale, { create: true })` leaves the `scope` row out of the Advanced section. Called without it (edit, view), the row is unchanged: `immutable`, read from `ManifestSchema`, because an existing package's scope can be `cloud` or `system`.
- `PackageFormDialog.tsx`: create mode asks for the create view, and its POST body is built without `scope`, even from a draft that holds one. The PATCH path, every other field, the help-text keys (`engine.packages.form.scope` and its help are still used by edit and view) and every `data-testid` are unchanged. No i18n or designer-table key is added or removed, and there is no list of scope values on the client.
- One changeset for `@object-ui/app-shell` (patch).

## Route and why

The triage note offered two routes. This PR leaves `scope` off the create form. That route is installable now: on create the server defaults `scope` to `project`, so offering nothing offers nothing the install door refuses. The other route derives the create options from `PackageInstallManifestSchema` (`@objectstack/spec/api`). It needs a spec release carrying objectstack `eda6f14b7b` (objectstack#24160), which `18.0.0-next.3` does not carry. That is the follow-up, as its own card, once objectui installs such a release.

## What the server answers for a create with no scope

Measured on the declarations, because the live backend refused the create for an unrelated capability reason (see Acceptance notes):

- The branch's POST body, captured off the wire: `{"manifest":{"version":"0.1.0","type":"app","name":"Scope Probe","id":"com.default.scope-probe","namespace":"scope_probe"}}`, with no `scope`.
- Published `@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0-next.2: `ManifestSchema.parse` of that manifest gives `scope: 'project'`.
- objectstack main: `PackageInstallManifestSchema` declares `scope: z.enum(['project'], …).default('project')` and refuses `cloud` / `system` with a 400 (objectstack#24160, the self-lock in objectstack#24062).

## The comment, before and after

Before: "Defaults for a new WRITABLE base package. Deliberately no `scope`: a runtime-created base is writable, whereas `scope: 'project'` marks a read-only CODE package (packages-io writability heuristic). Sending it would make every new package render as 只读."

After: "Defaults for a new package. No `scope`, and the create form offers none (objectui#12869): `POST /api/v1/packages` defaults it to `project` and refuses `cloud` / `system` (objectstack#24160). Whether the new package is writable is the server's verdict, the row's served `writable`, which PackagesPage reads; it is never guessed from `scope`."

## Live, before and after

Showcase backend from `e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh` (published `@objectstack/*@18.0.0-next.2`). Consoles were run from source: `main` at `2ec9e2a` and this branch. Light theme, zh-CN.

- `main`: Studio → 新建软件包 → 高级 shows a 范围 row offering `cloud`, `system`, `project`.
- This branch: the same section shows 默认数据源 and 依赖 only, with no 范围. The create POST carried no `scope`.
- This branch, Setup → Packages → 查看信息: 范围 shows `project`, disabled.

Access: this backend serves the seeded admin `systemPermissions: []`, so the drivers rewrite `GET /api/v1/auth/me/permissions` in the browser, the recipe objectui#12725 phase 3 used. The server still refuses package routes for that account: the create POST answered `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, and the view-mode shot uses a browser-stubbed `GET /api/v1/packages` with one authored `project` row. Because 18.0.0-next.2 predates objectstack#24160, the 400 for `cloud` / `system` could not be shown live.

Screenshots (evidence branch `claude/issue-12869-evidence`, not merged here):

- main, Advanced: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/431bad2862102ac054b8849c6bb305d1c1a8ab91/docs/design/findings/12869/main-create-advanced.png?raw=true
- main, scope options open: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/431bad2862102ac054b8849c6bb305d1c1a8ab91/docs/design/findings/12869/main-create-scope-open.png?raw=true
- branch, Advanced: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/431bad2862102ac054b8849c6bb305d1c1a8ab91/docs/design/findings/12869/branch-create-advanced.png?raw=true
- branch, after submit (403 from the server): https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/431bad2862102ac054b8849c6bb305d1c1a8ab91/docs/design/findings/12869/branch-create-submitted.png?raw=true
- branch, view mode with scope read-only: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/431bad2862102ac054b8849c6bb305d1c1a8ab91/docs/design/findings/12869/branch-view-advanced.png?raw=true
- README and drivers: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/431bad2862102ac054b8849c6bb305d1c1a8ab91/docs/design/findings/12869/README.md

## Test evidence (at f743496)

- New `PackageFormDialog.createScope-12869.test.tsx`: 7 passed. It pins: create view drops only `scope`; create renders no scope control in Advanced; the create POST carries no `scope` when the draft held `cloud`; CONTROL: edit and view show the scope disabled for a `cloud` and a `project` package.
- Every test naming PackageFormDialog / package-schema / getPackageForm (18 files): 151 passed. The existing `PackageFormDialog.*` pins are unchanged.
- Ablation, once per pin: create keeps the row → 2 red; POST spreads the whole draft → 1 red; every mode gets the create view → 4 red. Each was restored with `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `type-check`, `build` (dist completeness) and `lint` on the touched files for `@object-ui/app-shell`: exit 0, 0 lint errors. `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-i18n-designer-table-parity`, `check:new-line-citations`: exit 0.

## Deviations

None from the claimed file surface. objectstack#24160 / #24062 were read as the landed declaration in objectstack source, not as PR pages, because objectstack is attached read-only and its PRs are outside this session's GitHub scope.

## Acceptance notes

- `studio-design/packages-io.ts` still falls back to `writable = scope !== 'project'` for a row with no served `writable`. Every package created now is stored as `project`, so on a server that omitted `writable` the Studio switcher would mark a new package read-only. Current servers serve `writable`, so nothing reaches it today.
- PackagesPage hides View and Edit for `system` / `cloud` packages, so in the console the read-only scope row is reachable for `project` and scope-less packages; the `cloud` case is pinned by the unit control.
- The published 18.0.0-next.2 backend serves the seeded admin no `admin_full_access`, the observation objectui#12725 phase 3 recorded.
